title: Shift slide and legato slide
description: Four quarter notes in two slid pairs: a shift slide up string 3 from A3 (fret 2) to C4 (fret 5), then a legato slide up string 4 from E3 (fret 2) to G3 (fret 5). The slide lives on the departing note and names its destination by note id — shift and legato differ only in whether the arrival is re-picked, so the data model is identical and the type field carries the distinction. slideIn/slideOut (no target) are the other two members of the enum. The renderer does not draw slides yet; the goldens pin the annotated notes rendering cleanly on both staves.
